description: Leading a student-run club of 150+ members focused on expanding awareness and understanding of quantum information sciences and technologies.
Organizing workshops on Qiskit, quantum algorithms, quantum cryptography, and quantum machine learning.
Facilitating collaborative hackathons, guest lectures, and peer-led study groups in partnership with industry experts and university professors.
highlights: Established Christ University's first Quantum Computing Seminar, drawing 500+ participants.
Secured learning resources and access credentials to cloud quantum simulators for student research.
